chapter: Recollections of Trent's band and its influence
title: Meeting Jonah Jones in Louisville
summary: Jonah Jones approached Trent's band in Louisville; first played with him in Lil Armstrong's band.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: That's the first time you met Jonah, I guess.
That's the first time I played with him. I met Johah before that, I met him when I was with Trent. We were playing--just before we went into this hotel in Louisville--

He's from around there. He's from Louisville. Just before we went into the hotel, we played a colored dance at one of those halls and Jonah was there and he came up and said I'm Jonah Jones--of course that didn't mean very much to him, but we were a bunch of nice guys, I would say that about all of them, they took up with everybody.
They weren't snobs that would turn anybody away.
